source.notes: ICSE Grade IX school Unit Test - II in Mathematics (school not named). Header prints 'GRADE - IX', 'MATHEMATICS', 'UNIT TEST - II', 'MM - 20'. No year or duration is printed; examYear 2024 is taken from the file name (icse-class-9-ut2-mathematics-030424-2024). Section A (6 Marks) has a single question Q.1 with six MCQs i)-vi) and no per-item marks, so Q.1 is kept as one entry with the printed 6. Section B (14 Marks) says 'Attempt any seven questions' of Q.1-Q.10 but prints no per-question marks; the separately numbered questions are not merged and marks are not inferred, so each has marks 0 (placeholder), is flagged and set LOW. Section B numbering restarts at Q.1, so its questions are stored as B1-B10 to keep them distinct from Section A Q.1. The scan carries a student's ticks and underlining, which were ignored. Notation rebuilt inline from the page image. No answer key is printed.

questions.sectionTitle: SECTION - A (6 Marks) (Attempt all questions from this section)
questions.text:
Choose the correct answers to the questions from the given options:-
i) If a, b , c are sides of a triangle then area of triangle is given by (according Heron's formula) ,
a) √(s(s + a)(s + b)(s + c)) b) √((s − a)(s − b)(s − c)) c) √(s(s − a)(s − b)(s − c))
ii) Area of equilateral triangle is ,
a) (√3/4)(side)² b) (√3/2)(side)² c) (√3/4)(side)³ d) (√3/2)(side)³
iii) Surface area of cuboid is given by,
a) 2(lb + bh) b) (lb + bh + hl) c) 2(lb + bh + hl) d) (lb – bh)
iv) The mean of x - 1, x + 1, x + 3 and x + 5 is,
a) x + 1 b) x + 2 c) x + 3 d) x + 4
v) Median of the numbers 4, 4, 5, 7, 6, 7, 7, 3, 12 is,
a) 4 b) 5 c) 6 d) 7
vi) The difference between the maximum and minimum value of a variable is called ____.
a) data b) variate c) range d) class limits
